name: Wanna Get Lucky?
source:
You play as a social media reporter covering a string of mysterious serial deaths.

According to witness accounts, all the victims encountered a woman with pink hair shortly before their deaths.

Tracing a strange perfume found at every crime scene, you eventually come face-to-face with the enigmatic “Pink-Haired Woman.”

s she the key suspect, or something even more sinister?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3718920/Wanna_Get_Lucky/]Steam[/url]]
